frontier.hypothesis: Target's `li a0,4` is stolen into the branch's delay slot from the branch's TARGET THREAD, not moved backward from the same block - which means the C is a two-arm if/else whose `sound = 4` arm is the branch target, and the reason it survives to reorg is that tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c:726-860 is defeated by its own 'the test doesn't involve X' precondition: the test must reference the result variable while the result variable is NOT the destination of the field64 load.
frontier.mechanism: jump.c:832 requires `! reg_referenced_between_p (temp1, p, NEXT_INSN (temp3))`, i.e. the normalisation dies if the conditional jump's pattern mentions X (the result pseudo). If it dies, the store-flag gate at jump.c:1178-1181 also dies because reg_set_last then finds no pre-branch set of X at all and returns 0 at the CODE_LABEL (rtlanal.c:867-916), leaving the two arms intact for reorg's steal_delay_list_from_target to lift the else arm's `a0 = 4` into the slot and delete the resulting jump-to-next.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate C shapes in which the branch condition references the SAME local that the arms assign, while that local's value at the branch is not the loaded field64 byte - the floor-6 baseline is the degenerate case (local IS the load dest, hence `lbu a0`). Candidates to spell and measure: (i) the local carries the loaded byte but the arms write a NARROWER lvalue of it so the arm insns are subreg sets (which also trips reg_set_last_1's SET_DEST (pat) != x path at rtlanal.c:851-858); (ii) the condition is a compound test whose second half references the local. Measure each with sandbox --disable all --diff and confirm against the .jump dump that insn 290's equivalent is still present (normalisation defeated) before crediting any result.

frontier.hypothesis: The duplicated-call form (7/211, target's register seat already correct) closes if the two arms' jumps are still pointing at an ORIGINAL label - uid below max_uid and present in jump_chain - when jump.c reaches them, so the sibling-jump pairing loop at tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c:2011-2021 gets a chance to match them against each other 3 insns deep.
frontier.mechanism: Per the s6 XJDBG trace the arms are lost at tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c:2005: the minimum=1 own-label attempt WINS a 1-insn call-vs-call match against case 2's call_insn 418 (the insn that falls through into `confirm`) and retargets both arm jumps to a do_cross_jump-created label, uid 660, which jump.c:2012's `INSN_UID (JUMP_LABEL (insn)) < max_uid` guard then excludes from the pairing loop forever - and jump_chain is never updated for that label either.
frontier.next_probe: The own-label attempt only wins because a func_8005C650 call is the insn immediately preceding `confirm`. Test whether the `confirm:` block can legitimately begin with something other than a fallthrough from case 2's call - e.g. spell case 2 so its call is not the last insn before the label (the D_800A35DC increment or the field66 store ordered after it), which target's own asm ordering at .L80074A04-.L80074A1C may already license. Re-run BB2_XJUMP_DEBUG=1 through tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 on each spelling and check for a `chain-partner` entry on the arm jumps; a `DO_CROSS_JUMP` with newjpos 3 insns back is the win condition. Do NOT add a statement whose only purpose is to occupy that slot - that would be a dead-store/pad cheat and a first reach of an unsanctioned family.

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 9's jtbl_80015A0C table-offset residual closes once the hand-transcribed array is deleted from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same change that lands func_800747D8's real switch as committed C, mirroring the already-executed func_8006B578/jtbl_80015988 precedent.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 emits a switch's ADDR_VEC into the .rodata of the TU containing the switch; with the hand array still present in text1a_b_mid_rodata.c the sandbox's isolated single-function build sees a placement/offset conflict (ours `lw v0,24(at)` vs target `lw v0,0(at)`) rather than the real target layout.
frontier.next_probe: At final-submission assembly time only (not a src/text1b.c-only session): delete the jtbl_80015A0C array from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same commit as func_800747D8's C body, then re-measure with sandbox --disable all --diff.
